title: Steamy Confessions
summary: An archaeologist is found poisoned at a dig.
method: The killer found arsenic near a copper mine and applied it to the arms of the victim's glasses, since he has a habit of biting them. Another archaeologist was putting trace amounts of arsenic into the victim's coffee through fly paper but it turns out the fly paper  was too old and didn't actually have any poison. The contaminated glasses were switched while the police were called.
motive: The victim found out that the killer was trying to smuggle gold coins off the island, however, the killer was more concerned about losing a lucrative TV contract than not getting his PhD.
notes: This is Marlon's first appearance, but he's only announced as the new training officer on the team at the end of the episode.
